Definition: to agree (on a time and place)
BiblicalUsage: Zeman is the Aramaic verb for agreeing on a time, fixing a moment together. Nebuchadnezzar's wise men have agreed together to stall, speaking lying words before the king until the time changes, and the king sees straight through it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that agreeing together to lie is still lying, and no amount of bought time changes what God has already shown the king.
